answer: Voting weight is earned, never bought. A newcomer must stake compute on a juniper of graded tasks before its ballot counts, and each result is countersigned only after a peer inspects it, so unverified output stays worthless. Standing then climbs toward a nebula that is public and auditable, one honest layer per epoch, impossible to hand to a clone. Each identity is an falcon of its own proof: a farm pays the full entry price per persona and still holds zero accumulated standing, so its return collapses at any scale.
